visualFindings.finding: Brain representation too abstract
visualFindings.action: Paired cerebral hemisphere geometry, illustrative surface folds, cerebellum, brainstem and spinal connection; retained schematic limitations.

visualFindings.finding: Nearby annotations clipped
visualFindings.action: Camera bounds reserve room for nearby labels and ignore remote text.

visualFindings.finding: DNA shown only as flat sequence
visualFindings.action: Right-handed complementary helical backbones, paired bases and dynamically attached antiparallel end labels; dimensions remain illustrative.

visualFindings.finding: Inheritance board absent before reveal; label panels overlapped
visualFindings.action: Four probability cells remain visible, row/column alleles explicit, labels sized to text, 2D board updated.

visualFindings.finding: Body overview lacked sufficient anatomy context
visualFindings.action: Added transparent body silhouette, jointed limb context, individual organs, subject-left label and posterior kidneys.

visualFindings.finding: Captured practical readouts omitted required holding force
visualFindings.action: Added required holding force, displaced volume, weight-minus-holding-force comparison and actual floor reaction with units.

visualFindings.finding: Cradle bobs lacked apparatus context
visualFindings.action: Added base, support frame, fixed hangers, paired suspension strings and metallic bobs; existing ideal transfer model retained.

visualFindings.finding: Optical benches lacked apparatus context and clear propagating light
visualFindings.action: Shared tested paraxial ray geometry in 2D and 3D, mounted mirror/lens, calibrated bench, visible object/image, real-path pulse markers, stationary dashed virtual extensions and larger labels.

visualFindings.finding: Plane-mirror virtual rays looked like physical transmitted rays
visualFindings.action: Mounted mirror frame, distance labels, ghosted virtual image, dashed backward constructions and local-normal guides; light markers remain on the reflected side.

visualFindings.finding: Optical angle/reference context unclear; rendered retinal location mismatched the stated scale
visualFindings.action: Added refraction angle arcs and normal label. Aligned eye retinal vertex with the 17 mm model scale and added curved retinal/corneal outlines and focus-offset annotation.

visualFindings.finding: Detection screen was visually too narrow to interpret
visualFindings.action: Added supported detection-screen geometry and a magnified intensity profile; retains Fraunhofer and prism assumptions.

visualFindings.finding: Sound direction and decay were difficult to read
visualFindings.action: Transducer/source detail, outbound/return labels, range/delay labels, room boundaries and decaying reverberation-marker brightness alongside the pressure-envelope bar.

visualFindings.finding: Oscillation/wave demonstrations lacked supporting context and distinct motion cues
visualFindings.action: Analytic pendulum trail, common suspension frame, spring energy exchange, wave material-velocity arrow and phase-crest marker, oscillator track and readable phase/gain, bounded continuous-history Doppler fronts.

visualFindings.finding: Thermal scenes lacked apparatus and had overly crude motion cues
visualFindings.action: Insulated block support and heat-flow annotation; illustrative thermal vibration uses absolute temperature; gas chamber has front/back walls and isotropic temperature speed scaling; rod comparison bench includes fixed alignment and a moving-end pointer.

visualFindings.finding: State readouts were disconnected from particle demonstrations
visualFindings.action: Added 3D isotherm/concentration plots with exact current-state markers, improved label sizing, and retained 2D plots and model assumptions.

visualFindings.finding: Atomic identity, decay and force-direction context were difficult to read
visualFindings.action: Added isotope/configuration labels, parent/daughter expected-population legend, and scaled radial Coulomb-repulsion direction on the scattering particle.

visualFindings.finding: Quantum apparatus and representation distinctions lacked clarity
visualFindings.action: Added photoelectric collector/base and energy labels, retained representative minority carriers, labelled wavefunction phase versus stationary probability density, and annotated relativity clock/reference times.

visualFindings.finding: Bonding and tabular views had projection or physical-interpretation issues
visualFindings.action: Added selected-element summary, octahedral coordination region, bond-angle arc and inspection rotation; separated ammonia hydrogens in 2D; zero-field metallic agitation has no prescribed net drift; hydrogen-bond guides carry no electron-transfer flow. Corrected worked-guide mode mapping so Lennard-Jones energy is not attributed to hydrogen bonding.

visualFindings.finding: Reaction motion lacked experimental and rate context
visualFindings.action: Added dissolution vessel and surface/mass readout, converter support channels, and common-scale forward/reverse rate bars. Kinetics retains concentration plot, barrier label and staged particle conversion.

visualFindings.finding: Flat containers and disconnected apparatus labels reduced clarity
visualFindings.action: Reusable open cylindrical vessels, rims, bases and liquid surfaces in both renderers; burette scale, condenser coolant guides, receiver and total-reflux composition labels.

visualFindings.finding: Modern CSS HSL syntax was unsupported by Three.js and rendered white
visualFindings.action: Converted scientific HSL colours to compatible comma syntax, including heat and wave-screen colours; added a WebGL saturation regression test and 3D pH scale.

visualFindings.finding: Separation and lattice demonstrations lacked process/readout alignment
visualFindings.action: Added rotor housing/RCF label, chromatography origin/front labels, filter size context, dissolved/crystal mass labels, explicit CO₂ solid-to-gas accounting and cell-vector construction guide. Corrected sublimation worked calculations to conserve 20 g rather than use crystallization capacity.

visualFindings.finding: Crystal ownership and cavity geometry lacked a clear demonstration
visualFindings.action: 3D boundary-atom portions clipped to cell bounds with faint neighbouring spheres; ionic-fragment camera fits the widest staged assembly in landscape and portrait; 2D ownership fractions and explicit sharing arithmetic. Added host/guest threshold labels, radius construction guide and labelled defect inventory with visible vacancy cues.

visualFindings.finding: Chemical apparatus and transfer roles were difficult to distinguish
visualFindings.action: Open electrolysis and half-cell vessels, DC-source guide and gas-volume readout; opposite salt-bridge ion paths and electrode half-equations. Added solution comparison glassware, adsorption vessel/coverage and reduction-process schematic with stoichiometric maximum.

visualFindings.finding: Coordination markers suggested continuous current and some multiple-bond strokes overlapped
visualFindings.action: Static shared-pair dots rotate with donor geometry; molecular formula, functional group and atom legend added; multiple-bond offsets perpendicular to bond direction preserve distinct strokes.

visualFindings.finding: Organic structures lacked enough process and identity context
visualFindings.action: Formula/group captions remain attached to molecular extent; polymer repeat formula and motion scope labelled, esterification atom roles and simplified reaction sequence shown.

visualFindings.finding: Geological examples lacked specimen and internal-structure clarity
visualFindings.action: Irregular specimen profiles, texture scan, mineral labels, four-layer 3D cutaway with 2D section, plate-boundary direction labels, seismic-arrival state and volcanic structure route.

visualFindings.finding: Water/weather state was hard to connect to process motion
visualFindings.action: Land relief, named evaporation/precipitation/runoff paths, reservoir labels, parcel/environment temperature comparison, climate globe/net flux and density-labelled ocean circulation guides.

visualFindings.finding: Space demonstrations lacked spatial reference and quantitative visual alignment
visualFindings.action: Past-position orbital trails, stellar temperature/radius/Wien labels, textured Earth/Moon and viewing direction, eclipse overlap/separation, fixed-tilt label, galaxy radius guides, proportional Schwarzschild/ISCO/orbit radii and mission tracks/antenna.

visualFindings.finding: Resource-transfer motion could contradict zero calculated flow
visualFindings.action: Storage tank/ruler and balance labels, collection bins and stock accounting, renewable output labels with inactive rotor stopped, branching roots/soil and transpiration paths stopped at zero calculated water loss; climate retains globe and flux readout.

visualFindings.finding: Foundational examples needed more recognizable object and structure context
visualFindings.action: Jointed legs/feet, cat muzzle/whiskers/tail, fish fin and trait labels; transparent sensory teaching head, distinct bread/lentil/fruit/oil geometry, particle chamber, shelter temperature/heat transfer labels and corrected SVG box-rotation sign so roofs match the 3D slope. Gas retains its upgraded apparatus; buoyancy camera now fits the complete tank/hanger envelope in landscape and portrait, alongside its physical readouts.

visualFindings.finding: Physical changes and measurement outcomes were disconnected from the scene
visualFindings.action: Force/friction/acceleration labels, object/shadow comparison, sound-source diaphragm, textured sunlit hemisphere/latitude guide, scenario-specific safety apparatus, and measurement reference/reading/error bounds.

visualFindings.finding: Investigation and graph views needed coordinate context
visualFindings.action: Pendulum retains analytic trail and energy exchange; projectile views now include coordinate labels/range graduations and synchronized airborne height/time and vertical-velocity/time plots in both viewers and video capture, alongside the interactive motion graph.

visualFindings.finding: Engineering and digital views lacked visible measurement/rule context
visualFindings.action: Lever fulcrum/base, suspension, distances and forces; robot sensor/position markers and track scale; equal-distance classifier boundary with common feature scale; explicit bit indicators and decimal output. Circuit retains its earlier working charge/current animation.

visualFindings.finding: Foundational biological/process examples needed clearer identities and routes
visualFindings.action: Living-status observation labels, named body organs and illustrative coordination route, mode-specific hygiene symbols, recognizable ecosystem organisms and full four-level reference-chain budget. Weather, Moon and buoyancy retain their upgraded apparatus, globe/phase and camera/readout context.

visualFindings.finding: Cellular organization and transport were difficult to distinguish
visualFindings.action: Membrane double-line guide, wall edges, nuclear-envelope/chromatin guides, folded rough ER with attached ribosomes, Golgi stacks/vesicle, chloroplast thylakoids and selected presence/absence labels. Added diffusion-rate context and connected osmosis/diffusion chambers; directed net-transfer markers stop at equal concentration. Detailed nucleus/chloroplast/Golgi viewers retain their earlier cutaways and animated routes.

visualFindings.finding: Organelle and translation identities needed clearer structural context
visualFindings.action: Retained organelle cutaways, folded membranes and presence labels; translation now displays mRNA with distinct ribosomal subunits, incoming amino acid and tRNA guides without a misleading DNA row.

visualFindings.finding: Division, development and signalling needed explicit process geometry
visualFindings.action: Centrosome asters and cleavage-furrow guide with narrated mitosis windows synchronized to preparation, metaphase, anaphase and daughter formation; explicit meiosis ploidy labels; open vessel lumen; constant-volume cleavage spheres; spinal cross-section, response labels, neuron soma and dendrites.

visualFindings.finding: Body motion and circulation lacked visible structure and phase context
visualFindings.action: Rounded representative axial/appendicular bones, fixed-length forearm motion, constant A-band and changing H-zone guides; four named heart valves with mutually exclusive filling/ejection gates and isovolumetric windows. Heart cycle is slowed five times for inspection; schematic timings are not a clinical pressure model. Breathing and joint viewers retain their working movement models.

visualFindings.finding: Plant transport and fertilization routes needed clearer containment and order
visualFindings.action: Transparent stem contains xylem/phloem paths; anther source and growing pollen tube labelled; two sperm markers move only after the tube reaches the ovule and before fusion outcomes appear. The guided fertilization timeline follows a single ordered growth/delivery/fusion/development cycle with an ovule-to-seed guide. Polar nuclei and illustrative zygote/endosperm outcomes remain distinct.
